name: smwpatches-sprite-tile-remap
title: Sprite Tile Remap
description:
This patch allows you to remap the sprite tiles at $019B83 on a per level basis. Store the index of the table you want to the freeRAM you choose in levelinit (or in a block, for example, to change it mid-level). See the ASM file for instructions on adding new tables. The format of the table is the same as $019B83, see the ROM map for details.

Update 2021-01-06: Now uses Asar and it's SA-1 compatible.
